description: Check user name or group membership and branch authentication accordingly. Useful for conditional authentication rules.

parameters.notingroup: Check user is NOT in group

parameter_help.user: Branch based on username (e.g., user = rescue for emergency account)
parameter_help.notingroup: Check if user is NOT member of group (e.g., notingroup developers)

pam_stack_examples: auth [success=1 default=ignore] pam_succeed_if.so user = rescue service = login
auth [success=1 default=ignore] pam_succeed_if.so quiet user notingroup developers
notes: Used for branching authentication flow. Common use cases: emergency accounts, group-based rules, service-specific authentication.
